name: @red-cup-engineering/federated-capability-offer-discovery-cell

scripts.check: node --check lib/discovery.mjs && node --check src/protocol.mjs && node --check src/runtime.mjs && node --check src/adapter.mjs && node --check src/activitypub-offer.mjs && node --check bin/execute-a2a-task.mjs && node --check bin/server.mjs && node --check bin/activitypub-server.mjs
